skill.name: report-now
skill.description: Guides an agent to check live sources before writing timestamped status reports, compare changes, and identify information it could not verify.
skill.summary: Create current status reports from fresh checks, with source times and explicit verification gaps.
skill.author: rabbitdesigns22

security_audit.summary: Static analysis reported no findings, so there are no static verdicts to adjudicate. Review of SKILL.md found reporting instructions without evidence of prompt injection, credential theft, or data exfiltration. Live checks, report saving, and optional fixes depend on host tools and permissions.

content.user_title: Create Status Reports From Fresh Checks
content.value_statement: Old status reports can hide recent failures and unresolved work. This skill guides fresh source checks and produces timestamped updates with clear verification gaps.
actual_capabilities: Directs the agent to obtain the current time in the user time zone before reporting.
Guides fresh checks of services, metrics, queues, inboxes, pending work, and recent errors.
Requires a source and check time for every reported number.
Structures reports around a bottom line, area statuses, problems, required decisions, and unverified items.
Uses previous reports to describe changes, not as substitutes for fresh checks.
Instructs the agent to save timestamped reports for later comparison.
limitations: Provides instructions only, without bundled connectors, scripts, or monitoring infrastructure.
Requires host tools and authorized access to read live sources or save reports.
Cannot verify unavailable sources and must label those gaps rather than substitute old information.
Does not define approval procedures or implementation details for optional fixes.

use_cases.title: Check Service Health
use_cases.description: Request current service checks, recent errors, and unresolved incidents before preparing an operational update.

use_cases.title: Review Campaign Activity
use_cases.description: Summarize current leads, spending, and pending messages from accessible sources, with check times and changes since the previous report.

use_cases.title: Prepare Project Updates
use_cases.description: Verify pending tasks and project status before listing blockers, recent changes, and decisions requiring stakeholder input.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner: Current Status
prompt_templates.prompt: Give me the current status of [project]. Check accessible sources now, timestamp the report in [time zone], and identify anything unverified.
prompt_templates.scenario: Get a simple update grounded in fresh checks.

prompt_templates.title: Intermediate: Report by Area
prompt_templates.prompt: Check [services], [task source], and [inbox] now. Report each area, check times, problems, and decisions needed. Do not modify anything.
prompt_templates.scenario: Combine several live sources into a structured report.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: Compare Changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Use [previous report] only to identify checks and compare changes. Verify current metrics and pending items from [sources]. Label unavailable sources.
prompt_templates.scenario: Compare current evidence against a previous update without reusing stale results.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: Scoped Operational Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Check only [approved sources] for [period], using [time zone]. Make no changes. Cite check times, separate unknowns, and save to [approved location].
prompt_templates.scenario: Produce a bounded, read-only report with an approved storage destination.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Check the API and task queue now, using UTC. Do not change anything.
output: Bottom line: The API responded successfully, but the queue needs attention.
API: OK. The health endpoint returned a successful response at 19:49 UTC.
Queue: Warning. The queue dashboard showed 12 waiting tasks at 19:50 UTC; the oldest had waited 18 minutes.
Problems: Queue delays require investigation. No changes were made.
Needs the user: Confirm whether to investigate queue processing.
Not verified: Worker logs were unavailable.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Recheck pending leads against the previous report. Report in UTC without modifying records.
output: Bottom line: Pending leads increased; inbox activity remains unverified.
Leads: Warning. The CRM showed 8 pending leads at 19:59 UTC, compared with 5 in the 18:00 UTC report.
Changes: Pending leads increased by 3 since the previous report.
Problems: Inbox access failed at 20:00 UTC. No records were changed.
Needs the user: Restore inbox access.
Not verified: Current inbox backlog. Earlier inbox counts were not reused.

best_practices: Specify the reporting scope, time zone, approved sources, and whether any changes are authorized.
Keep source names and check times beside metrics, and explicitly mark inaccessible sources.
Save reports only to approved locations and use prior reports solely for comparisons and check planning.
anti_patterns: Presenting a previous report or remembered metric as a current observation.
Treating an inaccessible source as healthy or filling verification gaps with guesses.
Allowing unspecified fixes or saving sensitive reports outside approved storage.

faq.question: What does this skill produce?
faq.answer: It guides timestamped status reports with fresh checks, area summaries, problems, user decisions, and explicit verification gaps.

faq.question: Does it connect to services automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides instructions and relies on the host agent tools, configured integrations, and authorized access.

faq.question: Can it use an earlier report?
faq.answer: Yes, to identify checks and explain changes. An earlier report must not replace current verification.

faq.question: What happens when a source is unavailable?
faq.answer: The report must identify the source and verification failure. It must not present older data as current.

faq.question: Can it change systems or save reports?
faq.answer: Its instructions permit safe fixes and request timestamped report saving. Execution requires host tools and permissions; specify read-only scope when needed.

faq.question: Which language and time zone does it use?
faq.answer: The instructions call for the user language and time zone. Provide both explicitly when the context is unclear.
